sentences: In July 1830, Parisians overthrew their king in three days of revolution, and Delacroix painted this the very same year.
The woman holding the tricolor flag is not a real person but an allegory of Liberty herself.
Around her advance people of different classes: a bourgeois in a top hat, a worker, a boy brandishing two pistols.
That boy is often linked to Gavroche, the street urchin in Victor Hugo's later novel Les Misérables.
The bodies at their feet make no secret of revolution's cost.
The whole composition rises like a pyramid toward the flag at its peak, and red, white and blue echo throughout the canvas.
